response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.avg_wbc, pa.ratio, pa.ratio - om.mean_ratio AS gap FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE pa.ratio > om.mean_ratio ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10;
